name: UniETP
summary: 统一 AI2-THOR、VirtualHome、Habitat 和 BEHAVIOR 的具身任务规划与自动任务生成基准。
summaryEn: A unified embodied task-planning benchmark spanning AI2-THOR, VirtualHome, Habitat, and BEHAVIOR with automatic task generation.
scale: Four simulators with atomic, compositional, logical, linguistic, and grounding tasks
scaleZh: 四个仿真器，覆盖原子、组合、逻辑、语言和落地任务
license: See repository and upstream simulator terms
licenseZh: 见仓库及上游仿真器条款
access: Unified environment and task-generation code available
accessZh: 统一环境和任务生成代码可用
verdict: 跨四个仿真器统一评测具身任务规划泛化能力
verdictEn: A four-simulator benchmark for generalizable embodied task planning
wmNote: 统一观察、动作和场景图接口可用于生成可比较的规划轨迹。
wmNoteEn: Shared observation, action, and scene-graph interfaces yield comparable planning trajectories.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - woyut/UniETP: A unified benchmark for developing and evaluating generalizable embodied task planning agents · GitHub
evidence.statement: Unified interfaces expose observations, actions and scene graphs across four simulators with grounded task generation. Not an independent recorded corpus.
